description: This PHP class file defines the PimReportDataAPI class, which extends a base ReportDataAPI class to provide specific report-related API functionalities for the PIM component of OrangeHRM. It includes methods for obtaining report generator services, validating parameters, and retrieving report objects based on request parameters.

classes.name: PimReportDataAPI
classes.description: API class for handling PIM report data requests, including report retrieval and validation.

methods.name: getReportGeneratorService
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns an instance of ReportGeneratorService used for report operations.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Retrieves a report object based on the request parameters, validating the report name and report ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Constructs and returns parameter validation rules specific for fetching all report data.
